card.statement:
There exists a canonical isomorphism of functors

$\mathsf{F}\cong\bigoplus_{\mu\in X_{*}(T)}\mathsf{F}_{\mu}:\mathrm{P}_{\mathscr{S}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})\to{\mathord{\mathrm{Mod}}}_{\mathbf{k}}.$

Moreover, $\mathsf{F}$ is exact and faithful.∎
card.label: Theorem 10.4

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
